query: Apollo lunar flag assembly dimensions pole height flag size inches

facts.text: Standard Apollo lunar flags measured 3 by 5 feet, i.e., 36 by 60 inches.
facts.quote: The flag itself was a standard 3- by 5-foot nylon flag, with the only modification being a hem sewed along its top edge to allow a metal rod to slide through,

facts.text: The Apollo lunar flag was attached to an 8-foot flagpole, i.e., 96 inches tall.
facts.quote: The flag was attached to an 8-foot flagpole that the astronauts planted into the lunar soil.

facts.text: The horizontal and vertical poles of the Lunar Flag Assembly were each made of one-inch aluminum tubes in two telescoping parts.
facts.quote: The horizontal and vertical poles were each made of one-inch aluminum tubes in two telescoping parts, anodized with a gold color.

facts.text: Due to spacesuit limits, the flagpole total height was constrained to a 28-inch minimum and 66-inch maximum reach.
facts.quote: Due to the limits of the astronauts' spacesuits, the total height of the flagpole was limited to their 28-inch (71 cm) minimum and 66-inch (170 cm) maximum reach.

facts.text: The final Apollo 17 Moon flag was larger, requiring a 6-foot long horizontal pole, i.e., 72 inches.
facts.quote: This flag measured 20% wider and taller than the others requiring a 6-foot (1.8 m) long horizontal pole.
